lines.text: Carrying His own cross, Jesus goes to Golgotha, where they crucify Him between two others.
Pilate posts a notice reading The King of the Jews, written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek.
The chief priests ask Pilate to change the sign, and Pilate agrees and rewrites it.

wrong_details.true: Pilate refuses, saying 'What I have written, I have written.'

lines.text: The soldiers tear the seamless tunic into pieces, and Jesus gives His mother to the disciple whom He loved.

wrong_details.wrong: The soldiers tear the seamless tunic into pieces
wrong_details.true: The soldiers cast lots for the tunic instead of tearing it

lines.text: Jesus says He is thirsty, receives sour wine on a hyssop stalk, says It is finished, and yields His spirit.
